# Amprius Sets September 2026 Events Schedule


September 01, 2026 8:30 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_fc05149c44f254a23999e20be869b412/amprius/news/2026-09-01_Amprius_Sets_September_2026_Events_173.pdf)


FREMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Amprius Technologies, Inc.](https://amprius.com/) **(“Amprius” or the “Company”) (NYSE: AMPX)** , a leader in silicon anode lithium-ion batteries, today announced its schedule for September appearances and activities.


[Commercial UAV Expo 2026](https://www.expouav.com/conference-information/?_gl=1*d1hkhz*_up*MQ..*_gs*MQ..&gclid=CjwKCAjwhZDUBhBGEiwAbi5bjpeMXPsacUlSZB0wG7mMUiNS1CZNJRtLHliOs4t_gEWpt3mjlre5mxoCdUYQAvD_BwE&gbraid=0AAAAADiOmla-Fdwk9qSsZR3riUjKp-XP8)
**Date:** September 1-3, 2026
**Location:** Caesars Forum; Las Vegas, NV
**Event Details:** Amprius will exhibit at booth 1635. Members of the Amprius Business Development team are available for one-on-one meetings. If you are interested in scheduling a meeting with the business development team, please contactsales@amprius.com .


[Strato-Ops 2026 (Stratospheric Operations Conference International)](https://www.stratoops2026.com/)
**Date:** September 2-4, 2026
**Location:** ANA Holiday Inn Resort Miyazaki; Miyazaki, Japan
**Event Details:** Amprius CTO, Dr. Ionel Stefan, will participate in two sessions at Strato-Ops 2026. On Wednesday, September 2, from 4:00-5:00 p.m. JST, he will join the panel, “Supply Chain: Advanced Materials, Energy Systems, Communications, Payloads.” On Friday, September 4, from 8:40-9:00 a.m. JST, he will present “Lithium-Ion Batteries for Continuous Stratospheric Flight.”


[IMTS 2026](https://www.imts.com/)
**Date:** September 14-19, 2026
**Location:** McCormick Place; Chicago, IL
**Event Details:** Amprius will exhibit in the North Building, Level 3, at booth 236182. Members of the Amprius Business Development team are available for one-on-one meetings. If you are interested in scheduling a meeting with the business development team, please contactsales@amprius.com .


[H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference](https://hcwevents.com/annualconference/)
**Date:** September 14-16, 2026
**Location:** Lotte New York Palace Hotel; New York, NY
**Event Details:** Amprius CEO Tom Stepien and CFO Ricardo Rodriguez will meet with investors one-on-one at the event. If you are interested in scheduling a time to meet with management, please contact your H.C. Wainwright representative.


[DroneX Trade Show & Conference 2026](https://dronexpo.co.uk/)
**Date:** September 29-30, 2026
**Location:** ExCeL; London, UK
**Event Details:** Amprius will exhibit at booth U638. Amprius Chief Business Officer, Ronnie Tao, will also present in the Commercial Theatre in a 25-minute session titled “Extending Commercial Drone Range with Field-Proven Silicon Anode Batteries.” If you are interested in scheduling a meeting with the business development team, please contactsales@amprius.com .


[Evercore 9th ADAS, AV & AI Forum](https://www.evercore.com/our-business-and-capabilities/equities/corporate-access-conferences/)
**Date:** September 29, 2026
**Location:** Evercore Offices; New York, NY
**Event Details:** Amprius CFO Ricardo Rodriguez will participate in the Physical AI Suppliers Panel at 8:30 a.m. Eastern time. Rodriguez will also meet with investors one-on-one at the event. If you are interested in attending the panel or scheduling a time to meet with management, please contact your Evercore representative.


**About Amprius Technologies, Inc.**


Amprius Technologies, Inc. is a leader in advanced lithium-ion battery technology, delivering high-energy and high-power silicon-anode batteries with up to twice the energy density, range, and flight time of conventional graphite-based cells. Headquartered in Fremont, California, Amprius operates an R&D lab and pilot manufacturing facility for silicon anodes and cells. To support scalable production, the Company employs a contract manufacturing strategy, enabling rapid capacity expansion with minimal capital investment. Committed to driving innovation in energy storage, Amprius powers next-generation applications in aerospace, defense, and mobility. For additional information, please visit[amprius.com](https://amprius.com/) and the Company’s[LinkedIn page](https://www.linkedin.com/company/ampriustechnologies/posts/?feedView=all) .
